'''''Gold One''''' was a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]] under the command of [[Gold Leader]] [[Captain]] [[Jon Vander]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /> Vander most notably used ''Gold One'' in battles such as the [[Battle of Scarif]]<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> and the [[Battle of Yavin]], where it was destroyed when Vander was shot down by the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ANH" />

==History==
===Service to Mon Mothma===
In [[2 BBY]], ''Gold One'' was flown as escort for Mon Mothma's ship, the ''[[Chandrila Mistress]]''. When the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]] soon attacked the escort, ''Gold One'' and the rest of Gold Squadron formed a defensive perimeter around the ship. After the ''Mistress'' was destroyed and their attackers defeated, ''Gold One'' escaped.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

===Battle of Scarif===
[[File:GoldSquadronBattleofScarif-RO.png|thumb|300px|left|Gold One leads Gold Squadron into the Battle of Scarif.]]
When [[Rogue One]] intercepted the [[Death Star plans]] on [[Scarif]], ''Gold One'' along with the rest of Gold Squadron participated in the battle. After [[Jyn Erso]] transmitted the plans to the ''[[Profundity]]'', ''Gold One'' along with Gold Squadron jumped to [[hyperspace]] back to [[Yavin 4]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

===Battle of Yavin===
Following the [[Destruction of Alderaan]] and the [[Rescue of Princess Leia]], the Rebel Alliance prepared their final attack against the [[superweapon]]. ''Gold One'', piloted by Vander, participated in the battle. Upon making their way to the [[Meridian trench]], they were intercepted by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in his [[TIE Advanced x1]], when the [[Sith Lord]] shot down the fighter, taking Vander and [[R2-BHD]]<ref>{{LEGOCite|num=75365|name=Yavin 4 Rebel Base}}</ref> along with it.<ref name="ANH" />
